answer: Copying an answer as a result yields nothing, and producing 49 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the sable ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the raven review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the crystal gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. That is 26 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
